title: Field regions of a 1 m antenna at 10 GHz
caption: For λ = c/f = 3 cm and antenna size D = 1 m the reactive near field ends at λ/2π = 4.8 mm, the radiating near field extends to 2D²/λ = 67 m, and beyond that the far field has plane-wave behaviour with intensity ∝ 1/r². Antenna patterns must be measured beyond 67 m.
alt: A logarithmic distance scale from 1 millimetre to 1 kilometre with three regions: the reactive near field out to 4.8 mm, the radiating near field out to 67 m, and the far field beyond.
description: A horizontal logarithmic scale of distance from the antenna in metres.
λ = 3 × 10⁸/10¹⁰ = 3 cm. The reactive near field, where fields store energy and E and B are not in the ratio c, ends at λ/2π = 4.8 mm.
The radiating near field extends to the far-field distance 2D²/λ = 2 × 1²/0.03 = 67 m.
Beyond that is the far field: plane-wave-like, E/B = c, intensity falling as 1/r².

claims.name: the far-field distance is 67 times the antenna size
